offline.title: No Internet Connection
offline.message: You'll need an internet connection to proceed. Please connect to the internet and try again.

information.name: Information Library
information.description: Offline access to Wikipedia, medical references, how-to guides, and encyclopedias
information.feature2: Medical references and first aid guides
information.feature3: DIY repair guides and how-to content

education.name: Education Platform
education.description: Interactive learning platform with video courses and exercises
education.feature1: Khan Academy math and science courses

ai.description: Local AI chat that runs entirely on your hardware - no internet required
ai.feature1: Private conversations that never leave your device
ai.feature2: No internet connection needed after setup
ai.feature3: Ask questions, get help with writing, brainstorm ideas

step1.title: What do you want NOMAD to do?
step1.subtitle: Select the capabilities you need. You can always add more later.
step1.allInstalled: All available capabilities are already installed!

moreApps.title: Looking for more apps?
moreApps.description: Notes, data tools, and the full catalog of add-on apps are available any time in Supply Depot.

step1.confirmDisableAi: Turning off AI will discard your AI model picks, indexing policy, and remote Ollama configuration. Continue?

step2.title: Choose Map Regions
step2.subtitle: Select map region collections to download for offline use. You can always download more regions later.
step2.hint: Only need a specific country, or want the whole world? Individual countries and a full global map can be installed any time from the <link>Maps Manager</link>.
step2.empty: No map collections available at this time.

step3.title: Choose Content
step3.subtitleInformation: Select content categories for offline knowledge.
step3.subtitleOther: Configure content for your selected capabilities.
step3.noContent: No content-based capabilities selected. You can skip this step or go back to select capabilities that require content.

creatorPacks.title: Stock Creator Packs
creatorPacks.subtitle: Branded video collections from creators, downloaded for offline viewing in Kiwix.
creatorPacks.empty: No creator packs available right now.

ai.title: Configure {{name}}
ai.subtitle: Choose models to download and set how {{name}} handles new content.
ai.modelsHint: Select models to download for offline AI
ai.remoteMessage: Models are managed on the remote machine. You can add models from Settings > AI Assistant after setup, note this is only supported when using Ollama, not LM Studio and other OpenAI API software.
ai.noModels: No recommended AI models available at this time.
ai.autoIndexDescription: When you add new ZIMs, documents, or curated content, should {{name}} index them automatically so it can search them while answering your questions?
ai.changeLater: You can change this any time from the Knowledge Base panel inside AI Chat.

review.title: Review Your Selections
review.subtitle: Review your choices before starting the setup process.
review.noSelectionsMessage: You haven't selected anything to install or download. You can go back to make selections or go back to the home page.
review.autoIndexAlways: New content will be indexed automatically as it arrives so {{name}} can search it.
review.autoIndexManual: New content will wait for you to opt in from the Knowledge Base panel before {{name}} indexes it.
review.readyMessage: Click 'Complete Setup' to begin installing apps and downloading content. This may take some time depending on your internet connection and the size of the downloads.

notifications.needInternet: You must have an internet connection to complete the setup.
notifications.completed: Setup wizard completed! Your selections are being processed.
notifications.error: An error occurred during setup. Some items may not have been processed.

complete.offlineMessage: It looks like you're not connected to the internet. Installing apps and downloading content will require an internet connection.
complete.backgroundMessage: Feel free to leave this page at any time - your app installs and downloads will continue in the background! Please note, the Information Library (if installed) may be unavailable until all initial downloads complete.
